name: Restaurant Pizzeria Reblaus
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Restaurant Pizzeria Reblaus in Tirol!**

Indulge in authentic Italian flavors right in the heart of the Alps. Our cozy restaurant offers a delicious mix of traditional Austrian dishes and classic Italian pizzas, all made with the freshest ingredients.

Try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for a sweet treat or savor a perfectly baked **Tiroler Gröstl** for a hearty meal. Pair your dish with a glass of local wine or a refreshing beer from the region.

Located in the charming town of **Innsbruck**, we’re just a short stroll from the historic **Goldenes Dachl** and the lively **Herrenhaus**. Whether you're exploring the city or taking a break from your alpine adventures, our warm atmosphere and mouthwatering dishes will make your visit unforgettable.

Come taste the perfect blend of **Tirol**’s hospitality and Italy’s culinary passion—**Pizzeria Reblaus** awaits!
